verified_publishes.source: verification-receipts.jsonl (VERIFIED* verdicts only; a submit receipt is not a publish)
caveats: Threads/Bluesky API publishes live in api_daemon.log, not the receipts file, so their verified counts here are a lower bound.
305 verified rows carry no parseable timestamp (not epoch, ISO, or PT stamp) and are excluded from the 24h/7d windows (counted in verified_rows).

Verdict spellings are not normalized in the file (VERIFIED / VERIFIED_LIVE / verified / VERIFIED LIVE); counts merge all four. Platform tags merge facebook + facebook_page + facebook_profile into 'facebook'.
